fsm_states_sdram.name: Power Applied
fsm_states_sdram.description: RESET_n LOW; supplies ramping (VDD1/VDD2H/VDD2L/VDDQ); state undefined.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Reset
fsm_states_sdram.description: RESET_n LOW; logic reset; outputs Hi-Z; mode registers cleared.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Initialization
fsm_states_sdram.description: Mode-register program + ZQ calibration + initial WCK2CK sync before normal operation.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Idle
fsm_states_sdram.description: Banks precharged, timing met, MRs programmed. Ready for ACT-1/ACT-2, REF (ab/pb), MRW/MRR, SRE, PDE, or CAS/WCK2CK sync.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Self Refresh
fsm_states_sdram.description: Entered via SRE over the CA bus; no CKE; deep sleep (DSM) is the deepest sub-mode (DSE).

fsm_states_sdram.name: Mode Register Access
fsm_states_sdram.description: MRW (two CA cycles) or MRR; tMRW/tMRD/tMRR.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Activating
fsm_states_sdram.description: ACT-1 then ACT-2; row opening; tRCD before first column command.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Bank Active
fsm_states_sdram.description: One/more banks open; ready for CAS (WCK sync) + RD/WR/MWR, further ACT, or PRE.

fsm_states_sdram.name: WCK Synchronizing
fsm_states_sdram.description: After CAS WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR: lock internal WCK phase to CK before the transfer.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Reading
fsm_states_sdram.description: Read burst (BL16/BL32); DRAM drives DQ + RDQS at read latency.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Writing
fsm_states_sdram.description: Write burst (BL16/BL32); controller drives DQ + DMI framed by WCK; WRX fills without data.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Precharging
fsm_states_sdram.description: PRE / PREab; tRP before next ACT or MRW/REF/SRE.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Power-Down
fsm_states_sdram.description: Entered via CA command (PD); lasts until CS next goes high; no CKE.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Deep Sleep (DSM)
fsm_states_sdram.description: Lowest standby power; SRE with DSE; full re-init on exit.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_POWER_UP
fsm_states_controller.description: Hold RESET_n LOW; ramp VDD1/VDD2H/VDD2L/VDDQ; VDDQ to 0.5 V.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_INIT
fsm_states_controller.description: Deassert RESET_n; start CK; program MRs; ZQ calibration; initial WCK2CK sync.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_IDLE
fsm_states_controller.description: Schedule REFab/REFpb; track tREFI/tFAW; manage DVFS FSP.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_ACTIVATE
fsm_states_controller.description: ACT-1 then ACT-2; respect tRCD, tRRD_L/tRRD_S, tFAW.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_WCK_SYNC
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue CAS WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR; enable WCK only when needed.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_READ
fsm_states_controller.description: RD/RD32 at programmed RL; receive DQ framed by DRAM-driven RDQS; decode read link ECC.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_WRITE
fsm_states_controller.description: WR/WR32/MWR at programmed WL; drive DQ + DMI framed by WCK; encode write link ECC; use WRX.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_SELF_REFRESH
fsm_states_controller.description: SRE; deep sleep via DSE; re-init on deep-sleep exit.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_DVFS
fsm_states_controller.description: Switch FSP; change WCK rate; adjust RL/WL/ODT/Vref; DVFSC VDD2H/VDD2L.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_controller.description: Enter power-down via CA command (no CKE); mode lasts until CS next goes high.

fsm_hints.trigger: Commands are committed on the 7-bit CA bus referenced to the quarter-speed CK (two CA transfers per command). The controller is the sole bus master. High-speed transfers require a prior WCK2CK synchronization (WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR via CAS).
fsm_hints.rule: Deterministic latency; once committed, data movement on DQ is fixed by read/write latency and burst length. WCK and RDQS are enabled only when a transfer is imminent.
fsm_hints.abort: RESET_n is the true abort. Low-power entry is via CA command and persists until CS next goes high (no CKE pin).

anti_deadlock_rule: Controller shall honour all LPDDR5 timing parameters (tRCD, tRP, tRAS, tRC, tRRD_L/tRRD_S, tFAW, tCCD_L/tCCD_S, tRFCab/tRFCpb, tREFI, tWR, tWTR_L/tWTR_S, tRTP, WCK2CK sync windows, tMRW/tMRD/tMRR, tZQ*, DVFS/FSP-change and deep-sleep timings). Violations cause undefined behaviour with no protocol-level flag.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on or RESET_n, the DRAM enters its reset state. The initialization sequence (RESET_n deassert, supply ramp ordering with VDDQ=0.5 V, CK start, mode-register programming, ZQ calibration, initial WCK2CK synchronization) must complete before any user data command. Deep-sleep exit requires the full init sequence to be re-run.

default_ready_state_recommendation.CK_idle: Quarter-speed CK running/stable in active states.
default_ready_state_recommendation.WCK_idle: Disabled (not toggling) when no transfer is imminent; enabled only after WCK2CK sync.
default_ready_state_recommendation.CS_idle: Drives command framing; bounds low-power-mode duration.

configurations.name: Bank-group mode
configurations.description: 16 banks as 4 groups x 4 banks; tCCD_L/tRRD_L same-group, tCCD_S/tRRD_S different-group.

configurations.name: 16-bank / 8-bank mode
configurations.description: 16 flat banks or 8 banks per density.

configurations.name: WCK on-demand
configurations.description: WCK enabled only after WCK2CK sync; saves power vs a continuous data clock.

configurations.name: DVFS / DVFSC
configurations.description: Frequency set points with VDD2H/VDD2L core-voltage scaling.

configurations.name: Deep Sleep (DSM)
configurations.description: Lowest standby power; full re-init on exit.

timing_dependency_rule: Command/address (CA[6:0], CS) inputs (Vref(ca)) are set up/held around the CK edges (double data rate). DQ / DMI inputs (Vref(dq)) are set up/held around both WCK edges on writes. DQ outputs are launched edge-aligned with the DRAM-driven RDQS on reads. The internal WCK must be phase-locked to CK (WCK2CK synchronization) before any high-speed transfer; DFE / equalization must be trained for the active frequency set point.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: RESET_n rising + power stable + CK start
fsm_transitions_major.target: Initialization -> ZQ cal -> WCK2CK sync -> Idle
fsm_transitions_major.description: Program MRs, ZQ cal, initial WCK sync, ready.
Two activate cycles open a row; tRCD.
CAS syncs WCK; RD drives DQ + RDQS.
CAS syncs WCK; WR samples DQ on WCK edges; WRX fills.
CA command; DSE selects deep sleep.
Lasts until CS next goes high; no CKE.
